title: Mass Scanning Targets Exposed Vite Servers to Steal AWS Keys and Azure Tokens
content_md: In August 2026, automated threat activity targeting exposed Vite development servers increased significantly. Attackers aimed to extract cloud credentials, environment files, and infrastructure state data by exploiting a critical file-read vulnerability known as CVE-2026-39364. Honeynet telemetry recorded 807 session-grouped attacks and approximately 32,000 raw events during the monthly analysis period.
